description: Changes: adds one maintenance ticket at the hotel's maintenance address; never out of order, no photo, no assignee. No preview: the change is made when called. Makes one maintenance ticket, as Maintenance › New ticket does, reported by the person's assistant. Never takes a room out of order (the hotel's staff do that on the ticket). A ticket under the Rooms location needs the room. Returns the ticket number and its link. One of the two people the owner named. Needs the owner's sign-in.
